## `neuro.array.with`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Copies an array, then overwrites the value at the provided index with the
> given value. If the index is negative, then it replaces from the end
> of the array.

## Signatures

```ts
with(input: { array: <receiver>; index: number; value: T; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.with` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
